scope: original five findings and new regressions introduced by complete fix diff only
evidence_mode: fixed-source review; no tests or builds executed

original_dispositions.evidence: Behavior comparison now visits the committed sequence, including hidden descendants, and marks each node whose cached resolved layout inputs differ. Child-first revalidation rebuilds affected node measurements before reuse, removing root-only invalidation.

Changed reusable styles and visual states schedule Style work plus effective layout comparison instead of blanket Layout invalidation. layoutStyleDiff excludes paint-only fields; refresh and the existing resolver preserve mask/fill differences. Original color-only overmeasurement is addressed, but deferred geometry classification introduces R1-N1.

One node-owned record retains earliest/latest generation for four categories and a minimum sequence. Repeated notifications update fixed fields. Consumption under the session lock retains categories newer than the cutoff; the next UI boundary samples a monotonic sequence at least as new as the retained latest generation. Invalid-node cleanup and close still remove pending records. Bound is O(pending mounted nodes), not O(notification count).
original_dispositions.verification_kind: source proof; no hidden runtime queue-size accessor

original_dispositions.evidence: Parent measurement propagation now compares effective child output fields after child-first revalidation. layoutDirty can stop while overflowDirty remains on affected ancestors. Overflow cache checks current finite bounds and overflowDirty, so internal overflow is still recomputed where necessary and clean sibling summaries can reuse. The original unconditional measurement/summary path is addressed; R1-N2 blocks the newly introduced missing-root fast path.
original_dispositions.boundary: No claim of total CPU or allocation improvement: old/new scrollingHeight and traversal costs are not benchmarked.

original_dispositions.evidence: recordMeasure runs after non-Canvas, preview and final-constraint hit returns, before actual final Canvas callback. Both committing target and transient M1 miss branches are counted.

new_findings.title: Include unresolved behavior styles in pending-geometry validation
contract: design section 4 retains ordinary batch and viewport behavior
new_findings.introduced_by: F2 fix defers Layout classification; geometryMayChange was changed in the same fix but does not include pendingBehaviorStyle.
new_findings.evidence: scheduleBehaviorStyle sets only Style and pendingBehaviorStyle. Classification occurs at produce/public render, after ordinary batch operations. With clean root.layoutDirty and empty binding/node/structural queues, geometryMayChange returns false despite a pending dimension-changing style. ensureVisible then checks old logicalWidth/logicalHeight.
new_findings.public_counterexample: Warm a Text whose inline StyleUse specifies width=1 in an application root wide enough for width=3. In one batch, replace its inline style with width=3, then call its NodeRef.ensureVisible(rect: Some(Rect(2,0,1,1))). With no other pending work, old logicalWidth=1 rejects the valid pending rectangle and the batch exception closes the session. Before the fix, applyStyles marked Layout immediately and this check was deferred.
new_findings.remediation_boundary: Preserve pending-layout semantics for public geometry validation without restoring blanket color-only remeasurement.

new_findings.title: Revalidate dirty descendants when root cache is absent
contract: design section 5 complete cache dependency inputs
M011 glyph-policy changes combined with persistent cache inputs
new_findings.introduced_by: F4 separates measurementDirty from subtree layoutDirty and changes child cache eligibility to measurementDirty, but child-first revalidation only runs when the root layout still exists.
new_findings.evidence: A leaf Content change marks its own measurementDirty and its ancestors' layoutDirty only. A generated-marker policy switch discards only root layout. renderLayout takes the fresh-root branch and LayoutNode.measure reuses the intermediate ancestor because its own measurementDirty is false. At equal width that ancestor's constrain returns without descending; old leaf line indices survive with new Component text.
new_findings.public_counterexample: Column { Column { Text(observable abc) } }; warm Unicode snapshot at 3x1, batch observable=q, then snapshot at 3x1 with glyphMode Ascii. The old leaf line indices [0,1,2] address a new one-cluster array and paint accesses clusters[1], causing an out-of-range failure instead of the complete-reference frame q followed by two spaces.
new_findings.remediation_boundary: Apply child-first pending measurement revalidation, or equivalent subtree-safe eligibility, on root-cache-miss paths as well as retained-root paths.
